## Add the files

<GroupPanel groupId="framework" value="Vite" defaultValue="Vite">

`server.ts` goes at the project root and runs the agent: the model login, the sessions and the tools. `src/App.tsx` replaces the template's app with the chat, and `src/api.ts` connects it to the host. `useSyncExternalStore` reads the session, so React re-renders whenever the conversation changes.

```ts tab="server.ts"
import process from "node:process";
import { createInterface } from "node:readline/promises";
import { sqliteStore } from "@nyte-ai/host";
import { asId } from "@nyte-ai/schema";
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";
import type { Host } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";

const store = sqliteStore({ path: "./agent.db" });
const host = await sdk.open({ store });

const { providers } = await host.models.list();

if (providers.find((provider) => provider.id === "openai-codex")?.credential === "missing") {
  await signIn(host);
}

const chosen = await host.models.setDefault({ provider: "openai-codex", id: "{{modelId}}" });

if (chosen.kind !== "set") throw new Error("That model isn't in your account's catalog.");

const listener = await host.listen({
  // No port: the OS picks a free one, and the line below prints it.
  transport: { kind: "http" },
  auth: {
    kind: "custom",
    // Runs on every request and says who is calling. This one lets everyone in as the same user.
    authorize: () => ({
      // Principal ids are branded strings; asId turns "you" into one.
      principal: asId<"principal">("you"),
      // participant can start and use sessions. Owner calls, such as model sign-in, are refused.
      authority: new Set(["participant"]),
    }),
  },
  // The pages allowed to call the host: the address your dev server prints.
  origins: ["http://localhost:5173"],
});

console.log("Listening on", listener.address);

process.once("SIGINT", async () => {
  await host.close();
  await store.close();
});

async function signIn(host: Host) {
  const prompt = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  const login = host.models.login({ provider: "openai-codex", method: { kind: "oauth" } });

  for await (const step of login.steps()) {
    if (step.kind === "open") console.log("Sign in at", step.url, step.code ?? "");
    if (step.kind === "paste") await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    if (step.kind === "choose") {
      for (const option of step.options) console.log(`${option.id}: ${option.label}`);
      await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    }
    if (step.kind === "failed") throw new Error(step.reason);
  }

  prompt.close();
}
```

```tsx tab="src/App.tsx"
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { Session } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { useState, useSyncExternalStore } from "react";
import { startChat } from "./api";

export default function App() {
  const [session, setSession] = useState<Session>();

  return session ? (
    <Chat session={session} />
  ) : (
    <Composer onSend={async (content) => setSession(await startChat(content))} />
  );
}

function Chat({ session }: { session: Session }) {
  const view = useSyncExternalStore(session.subscribe, session.current);

  return (
    <main>
      {view?.messages.map((message) =>
        message.kind === "user" ? (
          <p key={message.id}>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
        ) : isPart(message, text) ? (
          <p key={message.id}>{message.state.markdown}</p>
        ) : null,
      )}
      <Composer onSend={(content) => session.send(content)} />
    </main>
  );
}

function Composer({ onSend }: { onSend: (content: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
  return (
    <form
      action={async (form) => {
        await onSend(String(form.get("content")));
      }}
    >
      <input name="content" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```ts tab="src/api.ts"
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import type { Session } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

export async function startChat(content: string): Promise<Session> {
  const connection = await sdk.connect({
    // The address `node server.ts` printed.
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:PORT",
    // No headers: the host lets this page in by its origin.
    credentials: { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) },
  });
  const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content });

  return session;
}
```

```svelte tab="src/App.svelte"
<script lang="ts">
  import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
  import type { Session, SessionView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
  import { startChat } from "./api";

  let session = $state<Session>();
  let view = $state<SessionView>();
  let draft = $state("");

  $effect(() => {
    const chat = session;

    return chat?.subscribe(() => (view = chat.current()));
  });

  async function send(event: SubmitEvent) {
    event.preventDefault();
    const content = draft;

    draft = "";
    if (session) await session.send(content);
    else session = await startChat(content);
  }
</script>

<main>
  {#each view?.messages ?? [] as message (message.id)}
    {#if message.kind === "user"}
      <p>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
    {:else if isPart(message, text)}
      <p>{message.state.markdown}</p>
    {/if}
  {/each}
  <form onsubmit={send}>
    <input bind:value={draft} aria-label="Message" required />
    <button>Send</button>
  </form>
</main>
```

```vue tab="src/App.vue"
<script setup lang="ts">
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { Session, SessionView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { ref, shallowRef, watchEffect } from "vue";
import { startChat } from "./api";

const session = shallowRef<Session>();
const view = shallowRef<SessionView>();
const draft = ref("");

watchEffect((onCleanup) => {
  const chat = session.value;

  if (chat) onCleanup(chat.subscribe(() => (view.value = chat.current())));
});

async function send() {
  const content = draft.value;

  draft.value = "";
  if (session.value) await session.value.send(content);
  else session.value = await startChat(content);
}
</script>

<template>
  <main>
    <template v-for="message in view?.messages ?? []" :key="message.id">
      <p v-if="message.kind === 'user'">
        You: {{ typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : "" }}
      </p>
      <p v-else-if="isPart(message, text)">{{ message.state.markdown }}</p>
    </template>
    <form @submit.prevent="send">
      <input v-model="draft" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  </main>
</template>
```

```ts tab="server.ts"
import { asId } from "@nyte-ai/schema";
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";
import type { Host } from "@nyte-ai/sdk";

const store = sqliteStore({ path: "./agent.db" });
const host = await sdk.open({ store });

const { providers } = await host.models.list();

if (providers.find((provider) => provider.id === "openai-codex")?.credential === "missing") {
  await signIn(host);
}

const chosen = await host.models.setDefault({ provider: "openai-codex", id: "{{modelId}}" });

if (chosen.kind !== "set") throw new Error("That model isn't in your account's catalog.");

const listener = await host.listen({
  // No port: the OS picks a free one, and the line below prints it.
  transport: { kind: "http" },
  auth: {
    kind: "custom",
    // Runs on every request and says who is calling. This one lets everyone in as the same user.
    authorize: () => ({
      // Principal ids are branded strings; asId turns "you" into one.
      principal: asId<"principal">("you"),
      // participant can start and use sessions. Owner calls, such as model sign-in, are refused.
      authority: new Set(["participant"]),
    }),
  },
  // The pages allowed to call the host: the address your dev server prints.
  origins: ["http://localhost:5173"],
});

console.log("Listening on", listener.address);

process.once("SIGINT", async () => {
  await host.close();
  await store.close();
});

async function signIn(host: Host) {
  const prompt = createInterface({ input: process.stdin, output: process.stdout });
  const login = host.models.login({ provider: "openai-codex", method: { kind: "oauth" } });

  for await (const step of login.steps()) {
    if (step.kind === "open") console.log("Sign in at", step.url, step.code ?? "");
    if (step.kind === "paste") await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    if (step.kind === "choose") {
      for (const option of step.options) console.log(`${option.id}: ${option.label}`);
      await login.answer(await prompt.question(`${step.message} `));
    }
    if (step.kind === "failed") throw new Error(step.reason);
  }

  prompt.close();
}
```

```tsx tab="src/App.tsx"
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/client";
import type { Session, SessionView } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import { createSignal, For, from, Show } from "solid-js";
import { startChat } from "./api";

export default function App() {
  const [session, setSession] = createSignal<Session>();

  return (
    <Show
      when={session()}
      fallback={<Composer onSend={async (content) => setSession(await startChat(content))} />}
    >
      {(chat) => <Chat session={chat()} />}
    </Show>
  );
}

function Chat(props: { session: Session }) {
  const view = from<SessionView | undefined>((set) =>
    props.session.subscribe(() => set(() => props.session.current())),
  );

  return (
    <main>
      <For each={view()?.messages}>
        {(message) =>
          message.kind === "user" ? (
            <p>You: {typeof message.content === "string" ? message.content : ""}</p>
          ) : isPart(message, text) ? (
            <p>{message.state.markdown}</p>
          ) : null
        }
      </For>
      <Composer onSend={(content) => props.session.send(content)} />
    </main>
  );
}

function Composer(props: { onSend: (content: string) => Promise<unknown> }) {
  return (
    <form
      onSubmit={async (event) => {
        event.preventDefault();
        const form = event.currentTarget;
        const content = String(new FormData(form).get("content"));

        form.reset();
        await props.onSend(content);
      }}
    >
      <input name="content" aria-label="Message" required />
      <button>Send</button>
    </form>
  );
}
```

```ts tab="src/api.ts"
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";
import type { Session } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

export async function startChat(content: string): Promise<Session> {
  const connection = await sdk.connect({
    // The address `node server.ts` printed.
    url: "http://127.0.0.1:PORT",
    // No headers: the host lets this page in by its origin.
    credentials: { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) },
  });
  const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content });

  return session;
}
```

## Run it

The host needs Node 26.4 or later:

```sh
node server.ts
```

The first run signs you in to your OpenAI account in the terminal. The login is saved in
`agent.db`, encrypted with the key in `~/.nyte/secret.key`, so later runs skip it. Copy the address
it prints into `api.ts`; the OS picks a new port each time the host starts.

```sh
pnpm dev
```

Open that address and send a message. The answer streams in as the host writes it. Before you put
this online, replace `authorize` with your own sign-in; see [Before you deploy](#before-you-deploy).

This chat draws your messages and the text answers. Tool calls and other parts are skipped here;
[Render a session](/docs/sdk/guides/render-a-session#draw-the-messages) shows how to draw them.

## Or a terminal app

The store works outside a browser too. Run this beside the host, with your question as the argument:

```ts title="tui.ts"
import process from "node:process";
import { isPart, text } from "@nyte-ai/plugin/core";
import { sdk } from "@nyte-ai/sdk/client";

const connection = await sdk.connect({
  // The address `node server.ts` printed.
  url: "http://127.0.0.1:PORT",
  credentials: { kind: "custom", headers: () => ({}) },
});
const { session } = await connection.sessions.start({ content: process.argv[2] ?? "Hello" });

session.subscribe(() => {
  const answer = session.current()?.messages.findLast((message) => isPart(message, text));

  if (answer === undefined || !isPart(answer, text)) return;
  console.clear();
  console.log(answer.state.markdown);
});
```

```sh
node tui.ts "What does this project do?"
```

## The folder it works in

The agent works in the folder you start the host from, and its tools run there without asking
first. It isn't a sandbox. Pass `workspace: { kind: "local", path }` to `sdk.open` to pick another
folder.

Context files (`AGENTS.md`, `CLAUDE.md`) load from the folder and its ancestors without trust;
start a session with `contextFiles: false` to skip them. The folder's extensions, such as
`.nyte/skills`, `.agents/skills`, `.nyte/prompts` and `.nyte/plugins`, load only once you trust
the folder:

```ts
const added = await host.workspaces.add({ kind: "local", path: process.cwd() });

if (added.kind === "added" || added.kind === "exists") {
  await host.workspace(added.workspace).update({ projectResources: true });
}
```

The decision is saved for the folder and the folders below it. To have tool calls ask first, run
`host.settings.apply("permissions", "ask")`. The desktop app and the terminal show those requests;
this chat doesn't, so leave it at the default while you build.

## Before you deploy

- Replace `authorize` with your own sign-in. It receives each `Request`, so it can read your session
  cookie and return that user as the principal, or `{ deny: "unauthorized" }`.
- Serve the host over HTTPS, and list your site's exact origin in `origins`.
- To give each device its own revocable credential instead, use
  [pairing](/docs/sdk/guides/choose-an-entry-point#give-each-device-its-own-credential).

The host is a long-running process. A serverless function can't be one, because it stops when the
request ends; for serverless, start from the Vercel template below.

## Deploy it

| Template                                                                                              | What runs                                                       |
| ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------- |
| [Cloudflare](https://github.com/interfaces-lab/nyte/blob/main/packages/examples/cloudflare/README.md) | One host in a SQLite-backed Durable Object, chat only           |
| [Vercel](https://github.com/interfaces-lab/nyte/blob/main/packages/examples/vercel/README.md)         | A Nitro app over PostgreSQL, with tools in a sandbox you supply |

## Extend it

Plugins change what the agent can do and how clients draw it. A core plugin adds tools, parts,
commands, settings and hooks, and loads in the host. A client plugin adds renderers, commands,
settings and keybindings, and loads in the app.
[Give the agent a tool](/docs/sdk/examples#give-the-agent-a-tool) is a complete core plugin.
